observations: Viewed the original cloud PNGs for EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04. All three added summary rows are visible: initial prefix 2, two different prefixes, four candidates with zero A/B duplicates.
Raw stored IDs and non-prefix thread flags remain visible, including flags [0,1] with enabled prefix zero.
The bottom notice explicitly leaves origin/HMAC/physical/OS/PM mapping unverified, selects neither provider and states that no hardware access was performed.

These screenshots do not open the tooltip. Individual candidate address/bit text is covered by Qt assertions and CLI JSON checks; the image review does not claim to have displayed every tooltip entry.
